# M3M launches invite-only Black Circle for luxury homeowners, targets ₹13,400 crore

 By The Standard Desk · India · 3 min read Published 30 OCT 2026, 1:39 PM 

 

Buying a branded luxury home from M3M India now comes with a key to a private club. On Thursday, the Gurugram-based developer launched M3M Black Circle. It is an invitation-only platform that lets its homeowners meet the people behind the global luxury brands linked to their homes.

The launch comes with a big growth target. M3M calls itself India’s largest player in branded residences. It plans to grow its branded portfolio from about 6.9 million sq ft to 10 million sq ft by the end of 2026. The company expects this to bring in an additional ₹13,400 crore in revenue. With only two months left in the year, that means adding about 3.1 million sq ft in a short time.

Paris debut with Jacob Arabo, Elie Saab Jr.

Black Circle began in Paris. M3M hosted owners of its Jacob & Co. and ELIE SAAB residences on a curated trip. They met Jacob & Co. founder Jacob Arabo and Elie Saab Jr. in person. The trip also included fine dining and private luxury cruises.

This is not the first such meeting. Earlier, buyers of M3M’s Trump homes met Donald Trump Jr. in the United States at his private invitation. Through Black Circle, the company says it wants to make this kind of access a regular part of owning one of its branded homes.

‘Not a trip, a sense of belonging’

“Luxury today is no longer defined by what you own, but by who you know and where you are welcome,” said Robin Mangla, President, M3M India.

“With Black Circle, we are opening doors that have traditionally stayed closed: to the founders, designers and visionaries behind the world’s most admired brands. What we saw in Paris was not a trip; it was a sense of belonging to a global circle,” he said. Mangla added that this was the new benchmark for branded living in India and the company intends to keep raising it.

Six projects, 500 owners

M3M and Smartworld together have six branded-residence projects:

– Three Trump developments

– Two ELIE SAAB developments

– One Jacob & Co. development

According to company figures, these cover about 6.9 million sq ft. Around 500 owners live in them.

More global brands on the way

M3M says it is in advanced talks with some of the world’s most sought-after luxury brands for new real estate tie-ups in India. As the portfolio grows, the company plans to roll out Black Circle across all of its branded residences.

For homebuyers, the message is clear. Developers in the luxury segment are no longer selling only space, design and amenities. M3M is now pitching exclusive access and curated experiences with global brands as part of the deal. The company says this will create a more personal and lasting ownership experience.

# M3M, Jacob & Co partner for ₹1,650-crore branded residences project in Gurugram

## Gurugram real estate: The branded residences project, located in Billionaire's Block in Sector 111 along the Dwarka Expressway, will comprise 120 units

Published on: Nov 17, 2026, 13:48:58 IST

By Vandana Ramnani

Gurugram-based M3M India has partnered with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co. for their second branded residential development in India, an ultra-luxury project in Sector 111 along the Dwarka Expressway in Gurugram. The development entails an investment of ₹ 1,650 crore and is expected to generate a topline of ₹ 3,300 crore, the company said in a statement on November 17.

M3M India partners with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co. for its second branded residential project in India, an ultra-luxury development in Sector 111, along Gurugram's Dwarka Expressway. (Photo for representational purposes only) (Pexels)

Named M3M Jacob & Co. Residences, the project will comprise 120 homes averaging approximately 7,300 sq ft each, with prices starting at ₹ 26 crore. The residences are expected to be launched at an average price of ₹ 40,000 per sq ft.

Located within M3M's Billionaire's Block, the project will be designed by international architecture and design firms Woods Bagot and Belt Collins. It will combine Jacob & Co.'s design philosophy with M3M's expertise in luxury residential development. The developer said the project would feature some of the largest residences along the Dwarka Expressway.

With this launch, M3M's cumulative development investment in Billionaire's Block will reach ₹ 2,750 crore, reinforcing its positioning as a destination dedicated to globally branded residences, the company said.

Spread across 170 acres along the Dwarka Expressway, Billionaire's Block is envisioned as an enclave exclusively for globally branded residential developments. M3M Jacob & Co. Residences will join the precinct's growing portfolio, with the developer planning to bring more international luxury brands into the development.

The developer also plans to bring five-star hospitality partners into Billionaire's Block. Building on its association with luxury hospitality brand Roseate at the Jacob & Co. development in Noida, the company said the forthcoming towers would combine distinctive branded design with personalised services.

M3M said only a limited number of towers would be developed within the 170-acre enclave, with subsequent phases expected to command a premium over earlier launches.

"For a discerning buyer, and for the ultra-high-net-worth investor thinking in decades rather than quarters, entering at this stage of Billionaire's Block's evolution is a decision that combines lifestyle, legacy and long-term capital appreciation. This is the kind of prudent, patient wealth-building philosophy that billionaire investors around the world understand well; get in before the market fully recognises the scarcity value," said Robin Mangla, president, M3M India.

## Second branded residence collaboration

The latest development marks the second branded-residence collaboration between M3M and Jacob & Co. in India, following their earlier partnership in Noida. Residences in the Noida project have reportedly traded at premiums of ₹ 3–4 crore over their launch prices, the developer said.

The ownership proposition at Billionaire's Block will also extend beyond the physical residence through M3M Black Circle, the company's private, invitation-only platform for homeowners in its branded residential developments.

Recently unveiled in Paris in the presence of Jacob Arabo, founder of Jacob & Co., the platform offers homeowners access to founders and visionaries behind leading global luxury brands, exclusive privileges and curated lifestyle experiences, the company added.

## M3M India has partnered once again with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co., popularly known as the "Watchmaker to the Billionaires", to develop an ultra-luxury branded residential project

M3M, Jacob & Co. announce second branded residences project in Gurugram; ₹1,650 crore investment planned

Sunainaa Chadha NEW DELHI 

4 min read Last Updated : Nov 18 2026 | 9:58 AM IST

#### Listen to This Article

Real estate player M3M India on Wednesday announced its second branded residential project in partnership with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co., committing an investment of ₹1,650 crore to develop 120 ultra-luxury residences at Billionaire’s Block in Sector 111, Gurugram, along the Dwarka Expressway.

The project, named M3M Jacob & Co. Residences, is projected to generate a topline of ₹3,300 crore, according to the developer. The residences will average approximately 7,300 sq ft each, with prices starting at ₹26 crore. The company expects an average launch price of ₹40,000 per sq ft.

The development will be designed by architecture firm Wood Bagot and landscape design firm Belt Collins. M3M said the project would feature some of the largest residences along the Dwarka Expressway, combining Jacob & Co.’s design identity with the developer’s luxury residential offering.

- The 120-residence development involves an investment of ₹1,650 crore
- Projected to generate a topline of ₹3,300 crore
- The residences will average approximately 7,300 sq. ft., with prices starting at ₹26 crore
- Designed by internationally renowned architecture and landscape design firms Wood Bagot and Belt Collins
- M3M’s cumulative development investment at Billionaire’s Block now stands at ₹2,750 crore

The 170-acre enclave is being developed as a destination dedicated to residences associated with international luxury brands.

The latest project marks the second collaboration between M3M and Jacob & Co. in India, following their earlier branded-residences development in Noida. According to M3M, homes in the Noida project have reportedly traded at a premium of ₹3–4 crore over their launch prices. The project also has a hospitality association with luxury brand Roseate.

The developer said the new Gurugram development would be part of a broader residential proposition that extends beyond the homes themselves. Owners will get access to M3M Black Circle, the company’s invitation-only privilege platform for branded-residence homeowners. Unveiled in Paris in the presence of Jacob & Co. founder Jacob Arabo, the platform is designed to offer access to luxury-brand founders, exclusive privileges and curated lifestyle experiences.

M3M also plans to bring five-star hospitality partners into Billionaire’s Block, making personalised services part of the residential experience. The company said forthcoming towers would combine branded design with hospitality-led services, building on the Roseate association at its Noida project.

The developer expects prices at Billionaire’s Block to eventually cross ₹1 lakh per sq ft as the enclave matures and additional branded towers are developed. This is a company projection rather than an established market price or independently verified valuation.

“For a discerning buyer, and for the ultra-high-net-worth investor thinking in decades rather than quarters, entering at this stage of Billionaire's Block's evolution is a decision that combines lifestyle, legacy, and long-term capital appreciation," said Robin Mangla, president of M3M India.

The launch comes amid developers’ growing interest in branded residences, a segment that combines residential property with the identity, design and services associated with luxury fashion, hospitality and lifestyle brands. For developers, such collaborations offer a way to differentiate high-end projects, while buyers are marketed an experience that goes beyond conventional luxury housing.

Spread across 170 acres on the Dwarka Expressway, Billionaire's Block is envisioned as the world's only master development dedicated entirely to globally branded residences, a single, curated address where each development carries the design signature, service culture and lifestyle of one of the world's most coveted luxury houses. M3M Jacob & Co. Residences joins the enclave's growing line-up of globally branded residences, with more global brands to follow.

The developer confirmed that Billionaire’s Block will bring together five-star hospitality partners to make exceptional service an integral part of the residential experience. Building on the association with luxury hospitality brand Roseate at Jacob & Co.’s Noida project, the forthcoming towers will pair distinctive branded design with attentive, personalised service, extending the promise of luxury from the residences themselves to everyday life.

More detail on the first Noida project

- The first M3M–Jacob & Co. collaboration was announced in October 2025 in Sector 97, Noida, on a six-acre site. At launch, the project was announced as a ₹2,100-crore development, with an estimated topline of ₹3,500 crore. It was planned in two phases:
- Phase I: 150 branded residences, with 3, 4 and 5-BHK configurations.
- Phase II: Around 100 ultra-luxury serviced residences.
- Launch pricing: ₹14 crore to ₹25 crore, with an indicated rate of around ₹35,000 per sq ft.
- Hospitality: Roseate was announced as the hospitality partner.
- Completion: The initial announcement indicated a three-year development timeline. The UP-RERA certificate subsequently listed July 31, 2030, as the proposed completion date.

## M3M India

Founded in 2010 by Chairman Basant Bansal and promoters Roop Bansal and Pankaj Bansal, M3M India has grown from a single land acquisition in Sector 66, Gurugram, into one of North India's largest real estate developers by sales volume. In roughly fifteen years the group has assembled a portfolio of 66 projects, delivered 43 of them encompassing 20 million square feet of completed space, and has another 23 projects covering 40 million square feet under active construction. A land bank of 3,000 acres and a customer base that exceeds 20,000 buyers underpin the scale at which M3M currently operates across Gurugram, Noida, Panipat, Manesar, and Chandigarh.

M3M positions every project — residential, commercial, or mixed-use — around three stated principles: Trust, Transparency, and Timely Delivery. That operating discipline is backed by a vertically integrated business model that manages each stage from land acquisition through project development, marketing, possession handover, and after-sales facility management. The integration keeps cost structures lean, construction timelines predictable, and quality control internal rather than delegated. It also explains why the company was able to repay Rs 2,473 crore of debt between April 2023 and August 2024, reducing total outstanding debt to Rs 1,302 crore — a financial posture that gives buyers and institutional investors confidence in its ongoing commitments.

The M3M portfolio spans luxury residences, ultra-luxury sky addresses, high-street retail, Grade A commercial offices, integrated townships, and plotted developments. Signature projects include M3M Golf Estate — a 56-acre residential complex that has won multiple architecture and luxury-living awards — M3M IFC, Trump Towers Gurugram, M3M The Cullinan in Noida Sector 94, and M3M 65th Avenue on Golf Course Extension Road. In Panipat, Haryana, the company delivered Phase I of M3M City of Dreams, a 350-acre plotted development representing an investment of Rs 2,700 crore — among the largest single plotted-development deals in recent Indian real estate history. New launches in 2025 and 2026 include M3M St. Andrews and M3M Jacob & Co. Residences, extending the brand into branded-residence territory.

M3M's ownership philosophy treats scale not as an end but as the precondition for consistent quality. The Bansal family leadership has deliberately chosen the luxury and ultra-luxury bands — where architecture, material specification, and location do the work that marketing cannot — over volume-driven mass housing. Each project is designed to function as a self-contained urban district: residences sit alongside curated retail, fitness infrastructure, landscaped open space, and co-working facilities. That integration reduces daily friction for residents and, over time, supports the capital appreciation that both end-users and investors seek when they choose an M3M address.

## Our Specialties

### Luxury Residential Developments

M3M's residential portfolio spans golf-themed addresses like the 56-acre M3M Golf Estate in Sector 65, sky residences such as M3M Altitude designed by UHA London, and ultra-luxury apartments like M3M The Cullinan in Noida Sector 94 — a project that received the Ultra Luxury Property of the Year 2025 recognition at the Times Business Awards. Configurations range from 2 BHK apartments to private-pool penthouses catering to HNIs and NRIs across Gurugram and Noida.

### Grade A Commercial Spaces

M3M IFC, awarded Commercial Project of the Year 2026 by International Brand Equity, anchors the group's office portfolio. Complementing it are high-street retail destinations including M3M 65th Avenue and M3M Route65 on Golf Course Extension Road, SCO plots in Sector 65, and M3M Urbana Business Park — a range that attracts global brands, corporate occupiers, and urban entrepreneurs seeking visibility in Gurugram's fastest-growing commercial corridors.

### Integrated Mixed-Use Townships

M3M's township model places residences, Grade A offices, retail, hospitality, and public green space within a single master plan. M3M Smart City Delhi Airport along Dwarka Expressway is the most ambitious example — a high-end residential and mixed-use commercial hub designed around seamless urban connectivity. M3M City of Dreams in Panipat, a 350-acre plotted development with 900 plots, demonstrates the same philosophy applied to Haryana's emerging Tier 2 corridor.

### Branded Residence Collaborations

M3M entered the branded-residence category with Trump Towers Gurugram, co-developed with the Trump Organization, and in 2026 launched M3M Jacob & Co. Residences — recognised as the Most Impactful Launch in Branded Residences at the Realty+ India Brand Leadership Conclave 2026. These collaborations introduce international design standards, globally recognised names, and bespoke service frameworks to the Delhi-NCR luxury market.

### Plotted & Industrial Developments

Beyond vertical construction, M3M has established a growing plotted and industrial land segment. The October 2025 expansion into Manesar introduced premium industrial plots with contemporary infrastructure alongside residential flats, capitalising on Manesar's rapid industrial growth. The success of M3M City of Dreams Phase I in Panipat — where 900 plots ranging from 140 to 180 square yards were offered — signals a deliberate push into land-based developments in Haryana and Uttar Pradesh.

## Excellence at Every Level

M3M operates through a vertically integrated model that keeps every critical function — from land acquisition and architecture to delivery and post-possession facility management — within the group. Buyers benefit from a single point of accountability, tighter construction schedules, consistent material quality, and a dedicated after-sales team that manages the community long after keys are handed over.

### Land Acquisition & Strategic Planning

M3M's in-house land team has assembled a 3,000-acre land bank across Gurugram, Noida, Panipat, Manesar, and Uttar Pradesh. Internal acquisition removes the intermediary cost and timeline risk that third-party land brokers introduce, allowing the group to move quickly on emerging corridors — as demonstrated by the Rs 7,500 crore commitment to new Uttar Pradesh developments announced at the UP Global Investors Summit.

### Design & Architecture

M3M works with international design consultants — including award-winning firm UHA London, which designed M3M Altitude — alongside in-house planning teams that handle master layout, unit typology, and landscape design. Keeping architecture coordination internal ensures that international design intent translates faithfully into construction documentation without the delays common in fully outsourced design pipelines.

### Sales & Customer Relations

An integrated sales and CRM function handles everything from initial inquiry through site visit, booking, documentation, and construction-stage communication. M3M's customer base exceeds 20,000 buyers, and the dedicated client relationship infrastructure — sample apartments, RERA-compliant specifications, and timely construction updates — is designed to give buyers clarity at every stage of the purchase journey rather than transferring that burden to channel partners.

### Construction & Project Execution

M3M's construction management function oversees all 23 projects currently under active development, covering 40 million square feet. Internal project controls — procurement, scheduling, quality audits, and subcontractor management — enable the company to deliver all projects launched prior to 2020 on schedule, a track record that underpins buyer confidence and repeat-investor demand across the portfolio.

### Facility Management & After-Sales

Post-possession, M3M's facility management division operates the common infrastructure, clubhouses, landscaped zones, and building systems across delivered communities. Each M3M project generates approximately 5,000 jobs across construction and post-delivery services including maintenance and property management, reflecting the scale of the group's on-ground operations even after handover.

## About M3M India — FAQs

Who is M3M India and what does the company name stand for?+

M3M India Private Limited was founded in 2010 by Basant Bansal, who serves as Founder Chairman, alongside promoters Roop Bansal and Pankaj Bansal. The name stands for Magnificence in the Trinity of Men, Materials, and Money, reflecting the company's founding philosophy around people, build quality, and financial discipline. Headquartered on the 41st floor of M3M International Financial Centre in Sector 66, Gurugram — a building the company developed itself — M3M operates across residential, commercial, retail, and mixed-use segments across the Delhi-NCR region.

In which cities does M3M India have active projects?+

M3M India's strongest operational base is Gurugram, where projects are concentrated across Golf Course Extension Road, Dwarka Expressway, Southern Peripheral Road, and Sohna Road. The developer has since expanded into Noida, with active developments in Sector 72 and Sector 94, and into Panipat, Haryana, where it operates the M3M City of Dreams township. The company has also committed Rs. 7,500 crore to new developments in Uttar Pradesh and is active in Manesar through the Gurgaon International City township.

What are the most notable landmark projects delivered by M3M India?+

M3M Golf Estate in Sector 65, Gurugram — a 56-acre luxury residential complex — is the company's flagship delivered project and has won multiple awards for architectural design, including recognition at the Indian Property Awards 2019. M3M IFC, a Grade-A office tower in Sector 66, established M3M's credibility with institutional commercial tenants and serves as the company's own headquarters. More recent landmarks include Trump Towers Gurugram, M3M 65th Avenue retail destination, and M3M City of Dreams, a 337-acre plotted township in Panipat representing a total investment of Rs. 2,700 crore.

How long has M3M India been operating and how large is its portfolio today?+

M3M India has been operating since 2010, giving it roughly 15 years of active development experience in the Indian real estate market. In that time, the company has delivered over 36 projects spanning 20 million sq ft of completed space, with all developments launched before 2020 successfully handed over. A further 21 projects covering approximately 40 million sq ft are currently under active construction, backed by a land bank of around 3,000 acres.

What is M3M India's reputation for construction quality and project delivery?+

M3M India uses a vertically integrated development model, managing every stage from land acquisition through construction to after-sales services internally, which enables tighter quality control and cost efficiency across large-format projects. The company's delivery record — all projects launched before 2020 have been handed over — is verifiable on the Haryana RERA (HRERA) portal and is cited as a key differentiator in the Gurugram market. Each project site employs an average of 5,000 people, and the group has reported generating over 1 lakh jobs in total across its construction and post-completion operations.

What global brand collaborations has M3M India undertaken for its residential projects?+

M3M India partnered with the Trump Organization in 2018 to develop Trump Towers Gurugram in Sector 65, one of India's most recognised branded residential projects. The company subsequently announced M3M Jacob and Co. Residences on the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, a Rs. 2,100 crore ultra-luxury development in partnership with the Swiss luxury brand. In January 2026, M3M announced a further collaboration with Lebanese fashion house Elie Saab for a branded residential project on Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram, committing Rs. 3,500 crore to this development.

How does M3M India's scale position it among real estate developers in North India?+

M3M India has grown to become ranked second among all real estate developers in India by sales volume and holds the number one position in North India, reaching that standing within roughly 14 years of founding. In FY 2024-25, the company recorded Rs. 11,000 crore in sales within just the first two quarters, with full-year targets set at approximately Rs. 30,000 crore. The developer describes itself as India's largest non-listed real estate company, with a customer base exceeding 20,000 and a portfolio spanning luxury residential towers, Grade-A offices, high-street retail, and large integrated townships.
